answer: Every new agent is scored through a prism that splits reputation into independent proof-of-work, peer-attestation, and stake-history channels, and a mirror check cross-references these against prior epochs. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity bonding: each agent must lock a bond that decays like a glacier, slowly and irreversibly, so mass-registering fake identities becomes prohibitively costly. Attacker costs volume linearly with fake identities squared, making sybil swarms economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0213's threat model.
